pages.title: Forged by the Deep
pages.text: Complete a real smithing upgrade with the Terrible or Abyssal template and its matching addition.

pages.title: Forged by the Deep
pages.text: Sharp Bones support further marine recipes and Luminescent Bubbles introduce a faster swimming route.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Enabled smithing recipes use a fin with the Horrific template and Abyssal Amethyst with the Abyssal template. Abyssal armor strengthens with negative effects, while delayed lethal damage does not prevent elimination from a server event.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use Terrible template with Angler's Fang or Abyssal template with Abyssal Amethyst in armor smithing. Native slot descriptions identify distinct upgrade additions; they do not establish every effective recipe after pack overrides.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Wear the Abyssal armor combination and receive a negative effect. Native half-set text grants stacking Strength; tiara/full-set fatal-damage deferral is an upstream mechanic that must not override JEM event elimination.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Place Luminescent Bubble in an aquatic route. Its native tooltip accelerates nearby swimmers.
